description: Proposed category corrections and extra categories, written from a read-only look at the production catalog (names, descriptions, photos) on 2026-11-23. Each entry names the product's current primary category; the tool skips an entry whose product has moved since. Only categories change: names, prices, stock and photos are never touched.
